summary: Iteration 8 completed for Gemini integration across backend and mobile-web frontend. Backend pytest passed 6/6 for Gemini chat (hi/en), real-image scan contract, model_used persistence in history, isolated Gemini->GPT fallback via monkeypatch, and voice-chat tuple/model_used compatibility. Frontend Playwright at 390x844 passed login, chat Gemini badges, scanner history/result model badge + confidence layout, settings Gemini active status, home weather/mandi regression, and no console/runtime/UI overflow issues.

minor.issue: language='hi' can return meaningful Romanized Hindi (Hinglish) instead of Devanagari script; content remains useful but script consistency is not guaranteed.

action_items: Optional: If strict script policy is required, adjust Hindi prompting/validation to prefer Devanagari output for language='hi'.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/server.py (>800 lines) into focused modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: Gemini primary + GPT fallback chain works as intended in isolated unit fallback test (no production config mutation).
Scan history persistence includes model_used and excludes Mongo _id in API response as expected.
/app/backend/server.py exceeds 800 lines and should be modularized (auth/profile/ai/weather/mandi/voice) for safer iteration speed.
seed_data_creation: Temporary scan records were created during tests and cleaned using DELETE /api/scan/history/{scan_id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL used: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. QA credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md are valid. Voice-chat endpoint is stable with multipart requests when Content-Type is not forced to application/json.
rca_of_issue: Observed intermittent 422 on /api/ai/voice-chat during early test draft was caused by test-client header contamination (session default Content-Type: application/json) breaking multipart parsing, not an app defect. Using requests.post(..., files=..., data=...) with only Authorization header resolved it.
